name: Screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the whole screen, an area you pick or the window in front, save it with the date and time in its name, and copy it to the clipboard if you like.
author: PerritoDeck contributors

actions.name: Take a screenshot
actions.description: Saves a PNG in the screenshot folder. Picking an area waits for you to drag one out on the computer.

fields.label: Also copy it to the clipboard
